newsitem.title: USA: Applied Biometrics begins to sell monitor.
newsitem.headline: Applied Biometrics begins to sell monitor.

text.p: Applied Biometrics Inc said Monday it has begun limited sales of its heart monitoring system for children and expects full marketing roll out by the end of 1996.

Applied Biometrics said it believes that its system is the only product available for routinely monitoring cardiac output in children. Initial results from this market indicate a strong interest and demand for this product, it said.
Applied Biometrics develops medical products designed to measure cardiac output during critical patient care.
Earlier today, the company reported a 1996 third quarter loss of about $363,000 compared with a loss of about $280,000 in the same period last year.
